headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 1,484 points and Nifty fell below 25,400 amid heavy selling in banking and metal stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Heavy selling in banking and metal stocks during the last session
NSE trading holiday for Guru Nanak Jayanti
whatHappening: Sensex shed 1,484 points while Nifty dropped below the 25,400 mark in the previous session
FIIs continued their 16-session buying streak, investing ₹5,672.99 crore despite the market decline
Indices initially opened higher despite weak global cues before a sharp afternoon sell-off
HDFC Bank and Reliance Industries identified among stocks with highest DII holdings in Q2
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti. In the last session, the Sensex crashed 1,484 points due to heavy selling in banking and metal sectors. Despite the sharp decline, FIIs remained net buyers for the 16th consecutive session.
